correctness.rationale: The insertion code E_j is independently geometric with P(E_j=k)=(1-q)q^k/(1-q^j), from q-weighted inversion factorization. Disjoint adjacent transpositions correspond exactly to E_j in {0,1} with no adjacent ones; selecting k nonadjacent path edges gives F_n(q)=sum binom(n-k,k)q^k and denominator q-factorial. Its recurrence characteristic roots yield log P=-2nq^2+O(nq^3+q^2) uniformly n>=2 as q->0, including the q=O(n^-1/2) threshold. Defect A_j=(E_j>=2), B_j=(E_j=E_{j+1}=1) each have q^2(1+O(q)) frequency. Disjoint-support factorial moments are asymptotically c^r; overlapping B runs need >=3 unit insertions, producing O(nq^3)->0 for nq² bounded; incompatible A/B overlaps contribute zero. Therefore the two marked types converge jointly to independent homogeneous Poisson fields for nq²->c>=0. Independently checked direct permutation enumeration and exact matching weights n<=7. This proves the stipulated finite and asymptotic claims, not fixed-positive-q Poisson behavior.
